verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for an agent evaluation platform, since one could ship scheduled backtests or suite runs. The evidence only covers SDK automation ("Automate workflows with Python..."), CI keys and real-time monitoring, and none of these documents a native recurring schedule. Running evaluations from a user's CI or the SDK is a user-side workaround, a one-off action rather than a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
